output_layout: N x num_ports x (2*seq_len) real-stacked float32
loop_summary: One hidden joint linear block and one output joint linear block, each followed by learned-dense residual correction; hidden ReLU is optional and output stays linear.

nodes.name: mixed_signal
nodes.why: The task provides one mixed complex sequence flattened into real and imaginary blocks.

nodes.name: normalized_input
nodes.description: Optional per-sample RMS normalization inside the model.
nodes.why: Normalization rescales values but does not change tensor width.

nodes.name: hidden_linear
nodes.description: First joint linear layer expands the input into one per-port real-stacked block.
nodes.why: The hidden affine layer maps width 24 to expanded width 144 = num_ports * (2 * seq_len).

nodes.name: hidden_port_features
nodes.description: Hidden representation reshaped into one real-stacked port tensor per port.
nodes.why: The expanded width 144 is partitioned into 6 port blocks of width 24.

nodes.name: hidden_residual_corrected
nodes.description: Hidden learned-dense residual correction adds back the mixed-signal reconstruction error per port.
nodes.why: The hidden block sums across ports, computes the mixed-signal residual, and adds a per-port learned dense weighting of that residual back to each port estimate.

nodes.name: flattened_hidden
nodes.description: Hidden port features flattened back into one expanded vector.
nodes.why: The per-port hidden representation is flattened so the output linear layer can mix information across all ports jointly.

nodes.name: output_linear
nodes.description: Second joint linear layer predicts the output per-port representation.
nodes.why: The output affine layer keeps expanded width 144 and produces the final per-port real-stacked blocks.

nodes.name: output_port_features
nodes.description: Output representation reshaped into one real-stacked port tensor per port.
nodes.why: The output width 144 is partitioned back into 6 port blocks of width 24.

nodes.name: output_residual_corrected
nodes.description: Output learned-dense residual correction produces the final separated port estimate.
nodes.why: A second learned-dense residual correction re-enforces that the separated outputs sum back to the mixed input while preserving signed residual contributions.

nodes.name: separated_channels
nodes.description: Optional output RMS restoration to the original input scale.
nodes.why: Rescaling restores amplitude but keeps the separated tensor shape unchanged.
